blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) personnel launched search and rescue operations for a 60-year-old fisherman who went missing in the waters off Polillo, Quezon, on Friday, Nov. 6. In a report, the PCG-Northern Quezon said the fisherman, a resident of Real town, left for a fishing trip aboard FBCA Triple J around noon on Friday, along with four other fishing boats. The FBCA Triple J reportedly encountered engine trouble near the shoreline, prompting the fisherman to return to shore for repairs.
